grounding.derivation: The campaign comment requires callers to verify a legitimate transition; hup enforces promotable before invoking campaign. promotable defines local eligibility to exclude any pending or in-progress snapshot. This is an implementation-level admission responsibility, not an independently assumed general Raft theorem. The asynchronous contract permits delaying snapshot append work while earlier normal apply work completes. Thus a full pending snapshot must continue preventing an explicit Campaign from starting an election until its matching completion is consumed.
grounding.applicability: An existing follower/voter receives a full newer snapshot in AsyncStorageWrites mode; no pre-vote, configuration change, restart or independent term input occurs between each Campaign invocation and its synchronous observation.
alternatives: Campaign returning nil does not imply admission; the method enters Step and can be ignored.
Other eligibility barriers can still prevent a campaign after snapshot completion; the duty is necessary, not sufficient.
Matching-prefix snapshot fast-forward does not establish a pending snapshot and is excluded.
